title: Red Hat Security Advisory: grafana security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: Red Hat has issued an important security advisory for Grafana on Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10. The update addresses three security vulnerabilities in Golang components used by Grafana: a certificate validation bypass (CVE-2026-33810), a denial of service in certificate chain building (CVE-2026-32280), and a cross-site scripting vulnerability via HTML parsing bypass (CVE-2026-27136). The update also includes bug fixes and enhancements, rebasing to Grafana version 12.4.3. These vulnerabilities affect the Golang crypto/x509, crypto/tls, and golang.org/x/net/html packages integrated with Grafana. The advisory provides updated packages for multiple architectures and recommends applying the update to remediate the issues.
